name: URTC-TESTER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; the Qt Quick diagnostics deck is the default, --legacy starts the classic Tkinter window.
notes: Real live CAN-bus diagnostic tool including CSV export of live graphs. The Qt Quick deck is the default, safety-first interface; the 25-tool Tkinter window is kept behind --legacy. Every output the screens send goes through the encoders in advanced_protocol.py, which reject out-of-range values instead of clamping them.
